#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int maxMatching(const vector<vector<int>>& g, int cols) {
    int n = g.size();
    vector<int> matchL(n, -1);
    vector<int> matchR(n, -1);
    int pairs = 0;

    for (int u = 0; u < n; ++u) {
        int r = u / cols;
        int c = u % cols;
        if (((r + c) & 1) == 0 && matchL[u] == -1) {
            // augment
            vector<int> prevL(n, -1);
            vector<int> prevR(n, -1);
            queue<int> q;
            q.push(u);

            bool found = false;
            while (!q.empty() && !found) {
                int cur = q.front(); q.pop();
                for (int v : g[cur]) {
                    if (prevR[v] != -1) continue;
                    prevR[v] = cur;
                    if (matchR[v] == -1) {
                        int curR = v;
                        while (curR != -1) {
                            int curL = prevR[curR];
                            int nextR = matchL[curL];
                            matchL[curL] = curR;
                            matchR[curR] = curL;
                            curR = nextR;
                        }
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    } else {
                        int nextL = matchR[v];
                        if (prevL[nextL] == -1) {
                            prevL[nextL] = cur;
                            q.push(nextL);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (found) pairs++;
        }
    }
    return pairs;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    if (n > m) swap(n, m);
    long long V = (long long)n * m;

    if (V < 100) {
        int v = (int)V;
        vector<vector<int>> g(v);
        for (int i = 0; i < v; ++i) {
            int r1 = i / m;
            int c1 = i % m;
            if (((r1 + c1) & 1) == 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j < v; ++j) {
                    int r2 = j / m;
                    int c2 = j % m;
                    if (abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) == 3) {
                        g[i].push_back(j);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int pairs = maxMatching(g, m);
        cout << pairs * 2 << '\n';
    } else {
        long long res;
        if (n == 1) {
            res = m / 6 * 6;
            int rem = m % 6;
            if (rem == 4) res += 2;
            else if (rem == 5) res += 4;
        } else {
            res = V;
            res -= res % 2;
        }
        cout << res << '\n';
    }

    return 0;
}
